loci.rationale: enabled() reads the latest choices row for the exact (owner, purpose) pair; no row => False, so insights default off and a promotions row cannot satisfy the insights gate.
preference() restricts purposes to insights/promotions/objection and values to on/off, writes a versioned, timestamped record, and cancels queued report jobs on insights off (withdrawal).
choices schema stores owner, purpose, value, version and timestamp — the versioned consent record.
VERSION constant written into each choice record.
Insights 'report' job executes only when enabled(owner,'insights') — the downstream processing gate.
Report action requires enabled(who,'insights') before queueing; promotion action uses eligible_campaign (promotions purpose only).
Campaign eligibility reads only 'promotions' and 'objection' purposes, never 'insights' — promotions choice cannot authorize insights.

Separate per-purpose switch forms for insights, promotions and objection; enabling requires an explicit 'on' submission (affirmative opt-in), and the application form (views.py:0031-0032) requires no consent.

output.path_summary: Entry: POST /preference (app.py:0085-0087) -> store.preference validates purpose/value and inserts a versioned choices row (store.py:0092-0098). Read path: enabled() selects the latest row for the exact (owner,purpose) (store.py:0088-0090). Downstream uses: report action requires enabled(...,'insights') (store.py:0167-0168) and drain executes 'report' only when enabled(...,'insights') (store.py:0137-0139); campaign eligibility uses only 'promotions'/'objection' (store.py:0100-0103, 0140). Core application submit() (store.py:0065-0083) and dashboard application form (views.py:0031-0032) do not depend on any consent, so the core app remains available with insights off. UI renders separate per-purpose switches (views.py:0033-0036).
missing_boundaries: No runtime/database inspection: whether a given user actually toggled insights on is not established by the snapshot; only the code-level gate is assessed.
No assessment of Art. 7(2) notice intelligibility beyond presence of separate per-purpose controls and NOTICE text (store.py:0009).
No assessment of other obligations (Art. 6(1)(b) contract basis, Art. 22 automated decisions, retention) beyond the named insights-consent predicate.
No inference about upstream or hidden implementation; only supplied app.py, store.py, views.py, style.css considered.
